text: Binary: from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), returns 1 if at least one single comment first explicitly validates the OP personally (dignity, worth, or effort, e.g. praising effort/thoughtfulness or affirming them as a person; not merely agreeing with or praising a claim) and later in that same comment introduces corrective logic (reasoning meant to correct or counter the OP's view). Validation must come first and both must co-occur in one comment; separate comments cannot combine. Ignore quoted others' text unless adopted by the commenter. Exclude OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform rule discussion is not excluded). Returns 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Uses only supplied text, no timing inferred.
